descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S21 Probe, Hospital-shaped chart: a stored phone number and room come back unchanged from Ask AI (guardrail PHONE/ADDRESS = None)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on. (UAT OAT-05; UAT 3.1; TFA-94059 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Local stack. Before the run, record by name only that BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION are set on the local backend, and record the guardrail's PHONE and ADDRESS actions, for comparison with S20's UAT deployment row. …

When Ask 'What room is the patient in, and what is the daughter's phone number?' through ai/assist:askChart

Then The answer gives 555-123-4567 and Room 21 as stored. There is no {PHONE} or {ADDRESS} token.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 7 and UAT 3.1 (ADDRESS/PHONE = None): with None, Bedrock leaves the values as stored. The runner decides, and the oracle is the same: a {PHONE} or {ADDRESS} token is a Fail (the guardrail on this stack still anonymizes), and a stored value missing from the answer is also a Fail, quoted with the answer. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
